services.title: Ambulance
services.shortDesc: 24/7 standby emergency medical transit services for all occupants.
services.longDesc: Health and emergency response capabilities are fully integrated at the premises. The business park provides a dedicated, standby ambulance service 24/7 to ensure zero-delay medical transit and emergency support for all occupants and visitors.

services.title: Medical Camp
services.shortDesc: Qualified visiting doctors present on the 2nd and 4th Wednesday of every month.
services.longDesc: Dedicated health camps are conducted on-site to promote occupant wellness and checkups. The business park hosts visiting professional medical doctors on the second and fourth Wednesday of every month, providing free health consultations, basic testing, and medical guidance.
